g.source: The gram, the canonical mass unit of every computation.

kg.source: SI prefix kilo: 1 kg = 1000 g exactly.

oz.source: International avoirdupois ounce = 1 lb / 16 = 453.59237 g / 16 exactly (international yard and pound agreement, 1959; not read in this session).

lb.source: International avoirdupois pound = 0.45359237 kg exactly (international yard and pound agreement, 1959; not read in this session).

ml.source: The millilitre, the canonical volume unit: 1 ml = 1 cm3.

tsp.source: US customary teaspoon = 1 tbsp / 3 = 4.92892159375 ml exactly (US gallon = 231 cubic inches, 1 inch = 2.54 cm; NIST Handbook 44 Appendix C and NIST SP 811 not read in this session).

tbsp.source: US customary tablespoon = 1 cup / 16 = 14.78676478125 ml exactly (US gallon = 231 cubic inches, 1 inch = 2.54 cm; NIST Handbook 44 Appendix C and NIST SP 811 not read in this session).

cup.source: US customary cup = 1 US gallon / 16 = 231 * 2.54^3 / 16 ml = 236.5882365 ml exactly (US gallon = 231 cubic inches, 1 inch = 2.54 cm; NIST Handbook 44 Appendix C and NIST SP 811 not read in this session).

count.source: A counted piece; its mass is the ingredient's own unitWeightG, never a default.
